# controld_device (Resource)

Manages a ControlD device. A device represents an endpoint (computer, phone, router, ...) that resolves DNS through a ControlD profile.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "controld_device" "laptop" {
  name       = "My Laptop"
  profile_id = controld_profile.home.id
  icon       = "desktop-mac"
  learn_ip   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `icon` (String) The device icon. One of: `[desktop-windows desktop-mac desktop-linux mobile-ios mobile-android browser-chrome browser-firefox browser-edge browser-brave browser-other tv-apple tv-android tv-firetv tv-samsung tv router-asus router-ddwrt router-firewalla router-freshtomato router-glinet router-openwrt router-opnsense router-pfsense router-synology router-ubiquiti router-windows router-linux router]`. Changing this forces a new resource to be created, as the ControlD API does not support updating it.
- `name` (String) The name of the device.
- `profile_id` (String) The identifier of the profile applied to this device.

### Optional

- `ctrld_custom_config` (String) Custom configuration overrides for the ctrld client running on this device. Not readable back from the API.
- `ddns_ext_host` (String) The externally managed hostname used for Dynamic DNS. Not readable back from the API.
- `ddns_ext_status` (Boolean) Whether external Dynamic DNS is enabled for this device. Not readable back from the API.
- `ddns_status` (Boolean) Whether ControlD-managed Dynamic DNS is enabled for this device. Only present in state once explicitly set; the API omits it entirely until then.
- `ddns_subdomain` (String) The subdomain used for ControlD-managed Dynamic DNS. Only present in state once explicitly set; the API omits it entirely until then.
- `desc` (String) A description for the device.
- `learn_ip` (Boolean) Whether the device should learn and remember the IPs it connects from.
- `legacy_ipv4_status` (Boolean) Whether legacy IPv4 resolving is enabled for this device.
- `profile_id2` (String) The identifier of a secondary profile applied to this device.
- `restricted` (Boolean) Whether the device is restricted to learned IPs only. Only present in state once explicitly set; the API omits it entirely until then.
- `stats` (Number) The analytics level for the device: `0` (off), `1` (basic), or `2` (full). Only present in state once explicitly set; the API omits it entirely until then.
- `status` (Number) The device status: `0` (pending), `1` (active), `2` (soft disabled), or `3` (hard disabled).

### Read-Only

- `device_id` (String) The unique device identifier used to build its DNS resolver endpoints.
- `id` (String) The device identifier (PK).
